messages:
sam: Heads-up — I need to pass my Sat daytime oncall (04/03) due to a flight delay. Window is 06:00-18:00 PT. Leaving quick handoff notes below, can someone cover either half?

jess: I can take 06:00-12:00 PT. Ping me ~05:45 if anything looks off. :thumbsup:

liam: I can cover 12:00-18:00 PT but I have a meeting 14:30-15:15; will be muted. If anything high-sev, please page and I'll escalate immediately.

sam: Thanks both. Key context: we observed the prod request queue spike yesterday — autoscaler sometimes flaps when queue > ~950k tokens/min which can push latency above SLO. If that happens, enable the small-model fallback policy to reduce tail latency.

sam: Console quick steps: `Settings -> Routing -> Fallback -> enable "small-model-fallback"`. Also monitor /metrics/queue_length and /alerts/oncall for related alerts.

marta: FYI infra scheduled a kernel patch on cluster-a at 09:00 PT Sat (auto-reboot). We requested a delay but it may still go through. If nodes become NotReady, follow the node-recovery runbook: 
```kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl cordon <node-name>
kubectl drain <node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl uncordon <node-name>  # after remediation
```

oncall-bot: Reminder: rota updated — jess assigned 06:00-12:00, liam 12:00-18:00. Please respond to pages within 15m.

sam: @jess can you confirm you'll create a short Notion handoff note when you take over? I'll update the calendar entry.

jess: Confirmed — I'll add the handoff note and list any ongoing follow-ups.

liam: Confirmed as well. If anyone starts a long-running mitigation, drop details here and I'll pick up after my meeting.

sam: Appreciate this team — I'll DM the oncall creds to both of you and update the rota once you're both set. Safe travels to me, and thanks for covering. :pray:
